KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. fupi
   B. zito
   C. nene
   D. pana

2. When practising herufi kubwa, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” herufi kubwa.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for herufi kubwa.
   C. Copy random text without understanding herufi kubwa.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to herufi kubwa.

3. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.

4. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   B. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.

5. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.

6. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.

7. When practising Huyo na Hao, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Huyo na Hao.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Huyo na Hao.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Huyo na Hao.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Huyo na Hao.

8. When practising Anga, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Anga.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Anga.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Anga.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Anga.

9. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mitoto
   B. mato
   C. kitoto
   D. watoto

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain herufi kubwa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Anga and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
